preconditions.description: The number of factories N must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of businessmen M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of years Q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= parent[i] <= i for i in range(1, N))
preconditions.description: Each factory's parent must have a strictly lower index than the factory itself.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= M for i in range(1, N + 1))
preconditions.description: Each factory must be owned by a valid businessman index.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= threshold[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(1, M + 1))
preconditions.description: Each businessman's threshold must be between 1 and 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N and 1 <= X <= 10**6 and 0 <= D <= 10**6 for F, X, D in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid factory index, donation amount, and dependency increment.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'rekt' or 1 <= int(stdout[i]) <= Q for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each output line must either be 'rekt' or a valid year number between 1 and Q.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout[i]) <= Q for i in range(M) if stdout[i] != 'rekt')
postconditions.description: If a businessman earns the threshold, the year must be within the range of Q years.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout[i]) >= 1 for i in range(M) if stdout[i] != 'rekt')
postconditions.description: If a businessman earns the threshold, the year must be at least 1.
